What is the smallest supported Direction decision for the continuing first-application-valid RETAIN/COPY/SHADOW agenda: a concretely justified next real-learning comparison, a narrower scientific scope, or a pause/closure at the smallest warranted unit?

This is new real learning evidence, not another synthetic check. On the same A03 ground-terminal host, one fresh paired seed trained CONTROL and FORECAST_PACKAGE for sixteen updates each. The package jointly uses Gaussian prediction mean/covariance supervision at coefficient0.025 and sigmoid before native service-probability inputs; control retains inherited mean-MSE/raw logits. Both retained PPO/AdamW, masks, service-label law, legal thresholds, causal information and native ownership. Each completed65,536 ordinary training transitions,512 optimizer steps and four final-checkpoint ordinary1,200-tick episodes. The mean service is470 in each arm; the four native returns are572,447,433,428 in both, with all differences0 against the declared+24-tick MEI. All eight episodes reached horizon, with matching row energy and no hard event or legal transfer.

The local intake accepts this complete inside-MEI observation and does not automatically buy unchanged-package seeds or longer training. It does not claim equivalence, no learning, family-wide futility, stable nonharm or state-source equality. The real learners have different final checkpoints, relative parameter displacement0.2358938486 versus0.2226763633, training service36,615 versus36,607 and eligible service-label counts8,641 versus8,649. Package optimization also had large finite per-update mean loss and pre-clipping gradient norm peaks:7,423,381.7265625 and22,054,892.236206055. All outcomes remain preserved. Mean-MSE and likelihood values have different definitions/scales; lower package target loss is not measured forecast improvement. Its lower final training BCE also comes from its own realized training data, not matched held-out calibration. The native outcome governs the package-performance question.

The binding MARL structure remains other-agent partial observability and state ownership during handover. Private history and messages feed active/shadow recurrence, motion/prepare/commit/forecast outputs, ordinary native certificates/actions and service, then real PPO/auxiliary learning. This pair still observed no legal transfer, so source effects remain unestimated. Finite competence, objective scale, deterministic action thresholds, shared representation and checkpoint/partner co-adaptation are competing explanations, not measured causes. No complete action trace, calibration result or tuned same-host headroom exists. Their absence is not permission to require exact cause, full-support census, upper-policy search or historical replay before an ordinary B.

Please reconsider what observation is worth buying, not just how to execute the same study again. One zero pair need not close a family; nor is another seed or more updates automatically the right next purchase. If you continue, identify a concrete changed learner/control question or justify why another independent seed/exposure would be decision-changing, with the strongest legal comparator and a native primary. A cheap existing-record analysis can be proposed only if it changes that decision and its useful input actually exists; it need not become a diagnosis-first gate. We recommend no automatic unchanged-package scaling and no stronger source claim from the current result. You may disagree with the recommendation on the evidence, but select one finite next discriminator or a precisely scoped stopping decision.

Full charged arm walls were340.645 and302.015s, below their original1800s ceilings. This is neither a demonstrated runtime explosion nor a causal speedup comparison.
